liam: Heads-up: just promoted the int4 build (zephyr-liteq) to a small dedicated canary. Seeing ~8/1000 toolcall parse failures flagged by the function-runner: majority are 'top-level not object' or 'missing actions'. Failing payloads often have an extra leading comma or are missing final "\]". Anyone seen this pattern with kvwindow/prefix caching?

nora: Do we have raw token captures for the failing traces? If the tail is missing that suggests stream truncation, but leading commas could be a tokenizer regressing to emit a stray punctuation token under int4.

diego: Pasted one sanitized fail from the capture (redacted ids):
```json
[  
  {"tool":"create_reminder","params":{"time":"14:00"}}
]
```
Note: runner expects {"actions":[ ... ]} so this is an array at top-level. Also saw one where we got "{"actions": [" then EOF (truncated).

liam: Baseline fp16 had zero of these in the same workload. Failures spike when we enable kvwindow=prefix and batch >=6. Also correlated with kernel variant 'fast-attn-v2' selection in logs.

nora: Two quick probes: (A) rerun with kvwindow=none and the same seeds, (B) rerun with sentinel anchor token appended to the prompt and a soft postprocess guard that rejects non-objects and triggers a limited retry. If (A) fixes it, kvwindow interaction is likely. If (B) reduces downstream impact, we can ship the guard as a hotfix.

infra-bot: canary 2026-04-05T09:10:00Z kicked off: job_id cj-900, model=zephyr-liteq, nodes=1, batch=6. Logs: https://ci.internal/canary/cj-900 :rocket:

diego: I'm going to capture the raw token stream hex and kernel selection for the failing set. If token boundaries line up with buffer refill points we might have an assembly bug in streaming.

qa-bot: quick stat from the first 2k replay: kvwindow=prefix => 7.9/1000 parse_fail; kvwindow=none => 0.6/1000 parse_fail. Anchored prompts (emit <END-ACTIONS>) down to 0.2/1000. Suggests strong kvwindow coupling.

liam: OK that's pretty decisive. Plan: 1) disable kvwindow by default for int4 canaries, 2) add runtime sentinel injection in the retriever layer (append anchor if not present), 3) add postprocess safe-wrap that converts top-level arrays into {"actions": <array>} and counts as a retryable event (max 2 retries). Diego, open a kernel-pick correlation ticket with logs.

diego: Will do — collecting token dumps now. If we confirm assembly/stream boundary bug we'll try a small patch to the streaming assembler that enforces atomic chunk join at sentence boundaries. Also will prod the runtime to prefer 'stable-attn' kernel for sequences >512 while we investigate.

nora: I'll prepare the emergency lint+wrap PR and a canary config to disable kvwindow on int4. Keep me posted if the token hex shows corrupted bytes vs legitimate punctuation tokens.

liam: Thanks — merging the lint+wrap into canary branch, and pausing wider rollout until we confirm. If anyone reproduces a non-retryable malformed case, paste raw capture here. :pray:
